In a bright indoor dining room, the curly blonde woman (R1) in a white blouse and black skirt stands on the left, shaking hands with the curly-haired man with glasses (R4) in a dark blazer on the right. In the background, the grey-haired man (R3) in a dark blazer embraces the blonde woman (R2) in a black blazer. A table with wine glasses and appetizers sits between them under soft, bright natural light from a window.
